work.title: On Growth and Form
work.author: Sir D'Arcy Wentworth Thompson
work.copyright_attestation: 100% Public Domain worldwide and in the United States. This Digital Scriptorium edition derives exclusively from D'Arcy Wentworth Thompson's 1917 Cambridge University Press First Edition (xv + 793 pp., 17 chapters, LCCN 18001383). Thompson's expanded 1942 Second Edition (whose copyright persists until 2037 in the US and only entered UK/EU public domain in 2019) and J. T. Bonner's 1961 abridged edition are strictly excluded—zero prose, pagination, or reorganized chapter headings are drawn from post-1920 editions.
